summary: The flow routes untrusted `request.getParameter("name")` through 52a→52b→52c, where in 52c each `names[i]` token is concatenated directly into a SQL UPDATE string and added to a `Statement` batch (CWE-89). I converted the sink to a `PreparedStatement` with a parameterized `where name=?` clause, binding each token via `setString`, so the batch-update feature (split on `-`, per-name hitcount increment, success counting) is fully preserved while input can no longer alter query structure. Only 52c needed changes; 52a/52b are passthroughs.
